name: ocr-service
description: Process PDFs and images locally with Apple Vision, then optionally use verified on-device Local Intelligence. Provides nine purpose-limited tools over local stdio after explicit external-provider acknowledgment. The localocr-mcp executable must be available on PATH; this extension does not bundle it.

tools.name: get_pdf_page_count
tools.description: Return the number of pages in a PDF.

tools.name: inspect_pdf
tools.description: Check whether a PDF already has searchable text, without running any OCR.

tools.name: ocr_pdf
tools.description: OCR a scanned/image-only PDF and return recognized text per page.

tools.name: ocr_pdf_batch
tools.description: OCR several PDFs in one call.

tools.name: ocr_image
tools.description: OCR a single image file (PNG/JPG/HEIC/etc.) directly via Vision.

tools.name: make_searchable_pdf
tools.description: Write a new PDF with recognized text embedded as an invisible, searchable text layer.

tools.name: summarize_document
tools.description: Create a grounded, temporary summary with page evidence using the selected local model.

tools.name: organize_document
tools.description: Suggest a grounded title, category, and tags without changing the source document.

tools.name: extract_document_fields
tools.description: Extract only requested fields with page evidence using the selected local model.
